superseded.add(replaced)\\n        elif isinstance(replaced, list):\\n            superseded.update(item for item in replaced if isinstance(item, str))\\n\\n    eligible = [record for record in \\\"status\\\": \\\"conflict\\\",\\n            \\\"value\\\": None,\\n            \\\"sources\\\": sources,\\n            \\\"unknowns\\\": [\\\"source disagreement\\\"],\\n        }\\n\\n    value =
